$comment: Dependency-update policy for scripts/aisha-deps-update.mjs (the repository's own replacement of .github/dependabot.yml). Cadence lives in .github/workflows/aisha-deps-update.yml (cron, opt-in via the DEPS_UPDATE_SCHEDULED repository variable). Semver-major updates are NEVER automated — majors land in bespoke PRs after a manual compat check, mirroring the dependabot ignore rule.
$internalScopesComment: Internal packages version through scripts/aisha-packages-publish.mjs (Verdaccio). The updater never bumps them directly; it REPORTS when a consumer resolves an older published version than the workspace source (the Verdaccio chicken-and-egg from ci.yml npm-audit-services) so the fix is: merge the package bump → publish → re-run updater.

targets.$comment: Discovered automatically from package-lock.json files (root workspace + standalone lockfile roots). This list only adds EXCLUSIONS.

security.$comment: npm audit findings at or above auditLevel get their own priority group in the plan (replacement for GitHub's out-of-band security updates) and are listed first in the PR body.
